copy-of-callsigns-21102024.csv.contentsIndicative: header 'Callsign,Product,Status,Type,Last Modified Date' with a UTF-8 BOM; 156,278 data rows. Status: 103,632 Allocated, 52,160 Reserved, 474 Available, 12 blank. Product (the licence class): 59,073 Full, 35,969 Foundation, 14,184 Intermediate, 1,893 Club, 97 Temporary Reciprocal, 45,062 blank. Type is 'Call Sign - Amateur' on every row (service discriminator, required-present but not carried). Last-modified dates run 2016-07-23 to 2024-10-21. Anomalies preserved verbatim: three callsigns carry a trailing non-breaking space ('G7IWE', 'G0TQK', '2E1HON' - the same trio as the 2019/2024 registers); lower-case 'g0jrk' and '2e1GTD'; interior-space 'G6 FMU'; and 481 four- plus 113 six-to-eight-character callsigns.

normalised--copy-of-callsigns-21102024.c.contentsIndicative: header callsign,status,licence_class,last_modified_date; 156,278 rows sorted by callsign. Status carried verbatim (Allocated/Reserved/Available and 12 blanks preserved); licence_class is the source Product verbatim (45,062 blanks preserved); last_modified_date ISO-rendered (day-first, verified by 69,839 day>12 values). The constant Type column is required-present but not carried. The trailing-non-breaking-space trio (G7IWE, G0TQK, 2E1HON) is trimmed - the only canonicalisation applied - and counted in the converter notes, never silent; because each also appears as a bare-callsign row, the three collapse onto duplicate callsign keys here (an honest consequence of trimming, preserved). Lower-case forms and interior-space 'G6 FMU' are preserved verbatim.
